narrative.overview:
Oak draws a repository the way a city draws its network. Branches are coloured lines, commits are stations, merges are interchanges, and the rest of the app speaks the same signage language: warm paper ground, black ink type, crisp 2px corners and saturated line colours.

The shell is an operate-mode tool and stays quiet. Colour is rationed: neutrals carry the chrome, and the eight line colours live mainly in the commit graph, where they carry meaning. The platform font (Segoe UI) was kept deliberately.

Only the Light and Dark base themes were redesigned. One Dark, Dracula and Solarized Light keep their own palettes and plug into the same token names.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper (Light) or neutral ink ground (Dark), with ink-coloured type
2px corners everywhere, driven by one radius knob
Eight saturated line colours, lifted in Dark so they hold against the ground
3px graph lines, hollow ringed stations, filled interchange dots
Flat: borders and tone separate surfaces, shadows only on floating layers
Tokens only: no raw colours, spacing, radii, font sizes or control heights in components

rules.name: The Lines Are Signage Rule
rules.body: Lane colours mean "this line". Do not borrow them as decoration on chrome; the interface accent is Line Blue only.

rules.name: The Token Source Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a variable from tokens.css. A theme may override any palette token; components never hold a literal.

rules.name: The Scale Only Rule
rules.body: Font sizes come from the five --text-* steps and weights from the four --weight-* steps; no component sets a literal size.

rules.name: The Nothing Moves Rule
rules.body: State changes use colour, tone, outline or inset bars only, never size, margin or position changes.

rules.name: The Flat Until Floating Rule
rules.body: Only layers that float over the app carry the shadow token; panels, rows and buttons never do.

rules.name: The One Focus Rule
rules.body: There is one focus system: a 2px --focus-ring, outline-based so it survives Windows high-contrast mode.

rules.name: The Station Grammar Rule
rules.body: Hollow means a commit, filled means a merge, a halo means HEAD. New graph marks extend this grammar; they do not invent a second one.

dos: Do take every colour, space, radius, font size and control height from tokens.css variables.
Do use 2px corners (the radius knob) and 1px borders for controls and rows.
Do keep the graph at 3px lines and an 18px lane pitch, and cycle eight lane colours.
Do use the single 2px focus ring, and inset bars for active rows.
Do keep surfaces flat and the shadow token for floating layers only.
Do keep hover, focus and selection free of layout shift.
Do check new colours against the Light and Dark values, and remember the three other built-in themes carry their own palettes.
donts: Don't use a neutral grey panel with a single blue accent as the look; warm paper and line colours are the identity.
Don't use lane colours as chrome decoration.
Don't add a second focus style, or replace outline rings with box-shadow rings.
Don't add raw hex, pixel or font-size values to component CSS.
Don't hold the redesign values as fixed for other themes; One Dark, Dracula and Solarized Light keep their own palettes.
